column7: sibling of dynamic-secret-kill-switch-revert-001 (#2698) on the lease table: RenewLease set ExpiresAt and persisted through UpdateDynamicSecretLease, a bare Save, writing the stale Status/RevokeError/RevokedAt back -- a concurrent successful RevokeLease became `active` again with a LATER expiry, so the row lied about a dead credential and kept holding a MaxActiveLeases slot until the sweep, and a revoke that had recorded `revoke_failed` was erased with its error. engine.Renew is a documented no-op on several backends (MySQL/Mongo/Redis), so nothing downstream would have noticed. Fixed by ExtendDynamicSecretLeaseExpiry: expires_at alone, WHERE lease_id=? AND status='active', with the renewal refused on no-match. The raw UPDATE normalises expires_at to UTC at the call site because it bypasses DynamicSecretLease.BeforeSave, which exists for ListExpiredActiveLeases' SQL range query (G81/INV-STORE-19). Red on real Postgres: status was active, revoked_at nil, and the lease still counted towards the active ceiling
